turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first; who decided that?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who entered that zero before anyone picked up a phone.
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Put it in an email yourself. I'm here about Owen, and I still don't have an answer to who decided on that zero.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No, Hale. Either you tell me who entered that zero and why nobody called me, or I'm going to the principal's office when I leave here.
